name: legaltech-monorepo
description: AI Litigation Navigator - Full-stack legal intelligence platform

scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && npm run db:seed && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:reset: cd backend && rm -f prisma/dev.db && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npx prisma db seed

author: Adam Pharrels
